report_name: China-Nexus Group Uses Autonomous AI Framework for Cyber Espionage

threat_actors.name: CL-STA-1238
threat_actors.description: A China-nexus threat actor that conducted a sophisticated campaign using the Cairn AI framework to autonomously attack organizations in the semiconductor, defense, and civil society sectors for intelligence collection.

attack_patterns.name: Active Scanning
attack_patterns.description: The Cairn framework, powered by AI agents, autonomously enumerated the attack surface of targeted organizations.

attack_patterns.name: External Remote Services
attack_patterns.description: The attackers supplied pre-gathered VPN credentials to the Cairn framework to guide initial access into target networks.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The AI-driven campaign used pre-gathered valid accounts, specifically VPN group names and passwords, to gain initial access.

attack_patterns.name: Gather Victim Host Information
attack_patterns.description: The autonomous AI agent performed reconnaissance to map the target host and network environment as part of its planning phase.

attack_patterns.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
attack_patterns.description: The Cairn framework and its AI agents executed commands and scripts to carry out reconnaissance, exploitation, and data retrieval tasks.

attack_patterns.name: Exploitation for Client Execution
attack_patterns.description: A custom skill pack named 'AIScan Runner Skills' was used by the Cairn framework to perform exploitation actions against targeted systems.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Local System
attack_patterns.description: One of the primary goals of the autonomous operations was to retrieve and exfiltrate data from the local systems of breached organizations.

tools.name: Cairn
tools.description: An open-source autonomous penetration testing framework weaponized by CL-STA-1238 with LLMs to automate reconnaissance, exploitation, and data retrieval.

tools.name: Zhipu GLM
tools.description: A Chinese-developed Large Language Model integrated into the Cairn framework by CL-STA-1238 to power autonomous attack agents.

tools.name: DeepSeek
tools.description: A Chinese-developed Large Language Model integrated into the Cairn framework by CL-STA-1238 to power autonomous attack agents.

identities.name: Semiconductor Sector
identities.description: Organizations in the semiconductor industry targeted by the CL-STA-1238 actor using the Cairn AI framework for cyber espionage.

identities.name: Defense Sector
identities.description: Defense contractors and related organizations targeted by the CL-STA-1238 actor using the Cairn AI framework for cyber espionage.

identities.name: Civil Society Sector
identities.description: Civil society organizations targeted by the CL-STA-1238 actor using the Cairn AI framework, likely for monitoring or disruption.

infrastructure.name: Cairn C2 Server
infrastructure.description: A server hosted in Hong Kong (154.44.31.4) used to host the customized Cairn framework for the autonomous attacks.

infrastructure.name: Attack Egress and Staging Node
infrastructure.description: A node in the U.S. (82.29.129.54) used for attack egress and staging operations by the Cairn framework.

indicators.name: CL-STA-1238 Cairn Framework C2 and Staging Infrastructure IPs
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: CL-STA-1238 Cairn Framework C2 and Staging Infrastructure
id: 9815e7c2-1a4b-4b1a-9c8d-3e7f8a1b2c3d
status: experimental
description: Detects network connections to known C2 and staging infrastructure used by CL-STA-1238 with the Cairn AI framework.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/cairn-framework-ai-autonomous-attacks/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-13
tags:
  - attack.t1071
  - attack.command_and_control
level: high
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    DestinationIp:
      - '154.44.31.4'
      - '82.29.129.54'
  condition: selection

indicators.name: Anomalous Outbound Traffic to Zhipu and DeepSeek LLM APIs
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Anomalous Outbound Traffic to Zhipu and DeepSeek LLM APIs
id: 87654321-abcd-4efg-8hij-klmnopqrstuv
status: experimental
description: Detects DNS queries for Zhipu and DeepSeek LLM APIs. Unusual traffic from servers could indicate a compromised host running an AI attack framework like Cairn.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/cairn-framework-ai-autonomous-attacks/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-13
tags:
  - attack.t1071.004
  - attack.command_and_control
level: medium
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate use of these LLM services.
logsource:
  category: dns_query
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName:
      - 'api.zhipu.ai'
      - 'api.deepseek.com'
  condition: selection

indicators.name: Cairn AI Framework Artifact 'AUTHORIZATION.md' File Creation
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Cairn AI Framework Artifact 'AUTHORIZATION.md' File Creation
id: fedcba98-7654-4321-8fed-cba987654321
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of 'AUTHORIZATION.md', a file created by the Cairn AI penetration testing framework to document bogus authorization for its tasks.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/cairn-framework-ai-autonomous-attacks/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-13
tags:
  - attack.t1074.001
  - attack.collection
level: medium
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\AUTHORIZATION.md'
  condition: selection

indicators.name: Cairn AI Framework Worker Process Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: Cairn AI Framework Worker Process Execution
id: 12345678-abcd-4efg-8hij-klmnopqrstuv
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of 'cairn-worker', a component of the Cairn AI penetration testing framework.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/cairn-framework-ai-autonomous-attacks/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-13
tags:
  - attack.t1059
  - attack.execution
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cairn-worker.exe'
      - '/cairn-worker'
    CommandLine|contains: 'cairn-worker'
  condition: 1 of selection
